source_evidence: Exact player 'We are here to look through the ruins and clear it out of anything dangerous. With luck you may be looking at new owners.' V states purpose and conditional future ownership to Hessa Marr at western crossing on Day331~16:20. Does not present grant, assert current title, negotiate fees, promise compensation or direct entry. Hessa independently reacts with cautious interest: welcomes removal of danger from old chambers; expresses concern over continued home and family ferry operation (three generations), not hostility to V. She tells party that the old stair is behind the abutment, inner door scarred, disturbing scraping and voices heard from behind it by residents, household avoids going inside. These are local observations/bounded testimony, not firsthand identification of exact custodians or archaeology. No new hazard, actor, fee, acceptance or site entry. V decides response. No check because ordinary voluntary initial conversation; no action/resources/elapsed substantive time.
